verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has no documented AI-training opt-out or no-training policy. Its self-hosting option, which gives full control over the environment, is an indirect workaround that keeps data on your own infrastructure. The paid BAA add-on for PHI on Trigger.dev Cloud suggests some contractual data protections, but says nothing about model training. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor no-training or data-usage policy, a training opt-out control for Cloud customers, and independent corroboration.
